setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays a four-step pattern, C3 D3 E3 F3 (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) at velocities 127, 117, 107 and 97, through the test MIDI device at 90 BPM with Rate /1 and channel range steps 1-4. The sequencer is stopped and a MIDI keyboard is connected as Mosaic's input. Every Mosaic option is at its default, so Map scale to white keys and the three Honour switches are Off, and the Scale Editor is on C major.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Play some keys on the keyboard: each sounds the note you pressed, because nothing is mapped yet. Tap K1 and open PARAMS > MOSAIC > Midi control. Select Map scale to white keys and turn E3 right to On. The row reads On.
steps.title: Turn on Map scale to white keys

steps.caption: Close the menu and play the white keys from C3 up to C4 on the keyboard. In C major they sound as written: 60, 62, 64, 65, 67, 69, 71, 72. The MIDI strip lists the notes Mosaic sent.
steps.title: Play the white keys in C major

steps.caption: Open the Scale Editor (grid (4,8)), turn E3 two detents and press K3. The Scale row reads Minor, natural minor.
steps.title: Choose natural minor in the Scale Editor

steps.caption: Return to the Channel editor (3,8) and play the white keys again: they now follow C natural minor, 60, 62, 63, 65, 67, 68, 70, 72 (C D E-flat F G A-flat B-flat C).
steps.title: Play the white keys in natural minor

steps.caption: Open the Scale Editor (4,8) again, turn E2 one click to Degree, turn E3 one detent and press K3. Degree reads ii°. Degree picks which scale note the keyboard's C starts on.
steps.title: Set degree II

steps.caption: Turn E2 to the Rotation row, turn E3 two detents and press K3. Rotation reads r2. Rotation moves the top keys down an octave.
steps.title: Set rotation 2

steps.caption: Tap the global transpose fader on the grid at its lowest value, then tap its increment button fourteen times, and return to the Channel editor (3,8). The Scale overview lists Transpose +2, which shifts everything.
steps.title: Set global transpose +2

steps.caption: The three Honour switches are still Off, so none of this is applied yet: the white keys still play 60, 62, 63, 65, 67, 68, 70, 72.
steps.title: Nothing applies yet

steps.caption: Tap K1 and open PARAMS > MOSAIC > Midi control. Select Honour scale degree and turn E3 right to On. The row reads On.
steps.title: Turn on Honour scale degree

steps.caption: Close the menu and play C3 to C4 again. Key C now plays the scale's second note: 62, 63, 65, 67, 68, 70, 72, 74 (D E-flat F G A-flat B-flat C D). Rotation and transpose stay unapplied, so you can start a phrase from degree II without changing the scale.
steps.title: Start from the chosen scale degree

title: Start from the chosen scale degree
